overall_notes: The paper focuses on unsupervised extractive summarization of emotion triggers. While humans were used for dataset annotation quality assessment, there's no explicit human evaluation of the system-generated summaries. The paper uses standard automatic metrics (ROUGE, F1) for evaluation. The main contribution is the Emotion-Aware PageRank model for emotion-specific extractive summarization.
